name: Lesinurad

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States

examples.title: A Phase 4 Safety and Efficacy Study to Evaluate Lesinurad 200 mg in Participants With Gout and Renal Impairment
examples.why: This action was a business decision \& not related to any efficacy, safety or clinical concerns with lesinurad.

summary: According to a small computer model rather than human tests, lesinurad received a medium score for liver risk and a low score for heart risk [M]. In the United States, this drug carries a boxed warning, which is the strongest warning placed on a medication label [1]. Additionally, an example test studying the drug in people with gout and kidney problems was stopped as a business choice and not due to safety, health, or effectiveness issues [4].
